subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned Barnacle PR-limit policy announcement remain open as the canonical notice, or should it be closed now that CONTRIBUTING.md and automation enforce the 20-cap policy?
rationale: The source and docs already match the issue, but the live pin/reopen history is a maintainer intent signal that cleanup automation should not override.

options.title: Keep pinned and open
options.body: Treat this issue as the live canonical notice while the policy remains active.

options.title: Close as docs-covered
options.body: Close it only if maintainers decide CONTRIBUTING.md and the automation comments are enough public notice.

options.title: Replace with another announcement surface
options.body: Move the notice to a dedicated contributor-policy page or Discord announcement, then unpin and close this issue.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned and open
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the live canonical notice while the policy remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman provided the strongest live maintainer signal by renaming, reopening, and pinning this policy issue after the docs PR landed.
